description: Ligne de bus transfrontalière Freund is a dataset listed in Open Data Saint-Louis Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Saint-Louis Agglomération. Tracé schématique de la ligne de bus transfrontalière Freund reliant la gare de Lörrach à l'Euro-airport de Saint-Louis depuis le 15 décembre 2024. La ligne dessert également Binzen, Haltingen et Huningue avec une fréquence d'une demi-heure. Services référents des données: Service Opendata: 03.89.70.46.67 Service Transport: 03.89.70.90.70. Coverage: Saint-Louis Agglomération (Haut-Rhin). The portal files it under Transports, Mobilités. Its keywords are Bus, Intermodalité, Projet Interreg. The portal shows 1 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-09-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-saint-louis-agglo-portal.
